items.title: Ramadan Begins Today as Saudi Arabia Confirms Crescent Moon Sighting
items.title_zh: 齋戒月今日開始
items.desc: Saudi Arabia confirmed the sighting of the crescent moon, marking the official start of Ramadan 1447 on February 18, 2026. Muslims worldwide begin the month-long fasting period.
items.desc_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯確認觀測到新月，2026年齋戒月（Ramadan 1447）於2月18日正式開始，全球穆斯林開始為期一個月的齋戒。

items.title: Tarique Rahman Sworn In as Bangladesh Prime Minister
items.title_zh: 孟加拉新總理就職
items.desc: Tarique Rahman officially became the Prime Minister of Bangladesh, marking the beginning of a new political era for the country.
items.desc_zh: Tarique Rahman 正式成為孟加拉國總理，標誌著該國政治新時代的開始。

items.title: US-Iran Indirect Talks: Preliminary Diplomatic Activities in Geneva
items.title_zh: 美國與伊朗間接會談前外交活動
items.desc: Oman's Foreign Minister met with US envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Geneva to prepare for upcoming US-Iran indirect negotiations.
items.desc_zh: 阿曼外長與美國特使Steve Witkoff及川普女婿Jared Kushner在日內瓦會面，為即將舉行的美伊間接會談做準備。

items.title: India and France Establish 'Special Global Strategic Partnership'
items.title_zh: 印度與法國建立「特殊全球戰略夥伴關係」
items.desc: The two countries announced closer strategic cooperation to address global instability. PM Modi stated AI models will be deployed globally to serve billions of users.
items.desc_zh: 兩國宣布建立更緊密的戰略合作關係，共同應對全球動盪局勢。莫迪總理表示AI模型將在全球部署，服務數十億用戶。

items.title: Saks Global Files for Bankruptcy Protection
items.title_zh: Saks Global申請破產保護
items.desc: Luxury retail giant Saks Global filed for bankruptcy reorganization, planning to leverage its premium real estate portfolio as leverage in negotiations with lenders.
items.desc_zh: 奢侈零售巨頭Saks Global申請破產重組，計劃利用其優質房地產組合作為與貸款人談判的籌碼。

items.title: China's 2026 Real Estate Policy: Control Supply, Reduce Inventory, Optimize Provision
items.title_zh: 2026年中國房地產政策：控增量、去库存、优供给
items.desc: The Central Economic Work Conference placed 'stabilizing the real estate market' as a priority. Key measures include controlling new supply, reducing inventory, and optimizing housing provision. Distressed developers like Sunac and Country Garden are emerging from debt restructuring.
items.desc_zh: 中央經濟工作會議將「穩定房地產市場」置於優先位置，關鍵措施包括控增量、去库存、优供给。融創、碧桂園等出險房企正從債務重組中走出。

items.title: Local Government Work Reports Set 2026 GDP Growth Targets at 5% or Above
items.title_zh: 地方政府工作報告設定2026年GDP增長目標5%或以上
items.desc: Most provinces set 2026 GDP growth targets at 5% or above, with Tibet targeting over 7%. Key focuses include stabilizing real estate, urban renewal, housing security, and building 'good houses'.
items.desc_zh: 大多數省份將2026年GDP增長目標設定在5%或以上，西藏目標超過7%。重點包括穩定房地產、城市更新、住房保障和建設「好房子」。

items.title: China's Public Fund Industry Reaches 37.71 Trillion Yuan by End of 2025
items.title_zh: 截至2025年末中國公募基金規模達37.71萬億元
items.desc: China's publicly offered fund industry assets under management reached 37.71 trillion yuan by the end of 2025, showing steady growth in the asset management sector.
items.desc_zh: 截至2025年末，中國公募基金規模達37.71萬億元，顯示資產管理行業穩步增長。

items.title: Beijing to Issue 80,000 Additional New Energy Vehicle Quotas in 2026
items.title_zh: 北京2026年增發8萬個新能源小客車指標
items.desc: Beijing announced it will issue 80,000 additional new energy vehicle quotas in 2026 to promote green transportation and support the new energy vehicle industry.
items.desc_zh: 北京宣布2026年將增發8萬個新能源小客車指標，以促進綠色出行和支持新能源汽車產業。

items.title: Shanghai and Shenzhen Exchanges Support Overseas Institutional Investors in Bond Repos
items.title_zh: 滬深交易所支持境外機構投資者開展債券回購
items.desc: The Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges, together with China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation, issued notices supporting overseas institutional investors in conducting exchange bond repurchase business.
items.desc_zh: 滬深交易所與中國證券登記結算公司聯合發布通知，支持境外機構投資者開展交易所債券回購業務。

items.title: Hong Kong Budget 2026-27: Multiple Measures for Stock Market, Property, and AI
items.title_zh: 香港2026-27財政預算案：股市、樓市、AI多方面措施
items.desc: Financial Secretary Paul Chan announced the 2026-27 budget with measures including HKEX preparing 'Tech Enterprise Express Lane', optimizing Stock Connect, introducing stock block trading, and accelerating development of the Northern Metropolis.
items.desc_zh: 財政司司長陳茂波公布2026-27年度財政預算案，措施包括港交所籌備「科企專線」、優化互聯互通、引入股票大宗交易、加速北部都會區發展。

items.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Closed for Lunar New Year Holiday Until Feb 24
items.title_zh: 港股農曆新年假期休市至2月24日
items.desc: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange is closed from February 15 to February 23 for the Lunar New Year holiday. Trading will resume on February 24. Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect services are also suspended.
items.desc_zh: 香港聯交所2月15日至2月23日因農曆新年假期休市，2月24日恢復交易。滬港通服務亦暫停。

items.title: Hong Kong Daily Stock Turnover Reaches Record HK$297.3 Billion
items.title_zh: 港股日均成交額創紀錄達2973億港元
items.desc: Hong Kong's daily stock turnover increased from about HK$100 billion to a record HK$297.3 billion in February 2026. Stamp duty revenue is expected to exceed last year's figures significantly.
items.desc_zh: 港股日均成交額從約1000億港元增至2026年2月的創紀錄2973億港元。印花稅收入預計將大幅超过去年數字。

items.title: Supermarket Operating Hours During Lunar New Year Holiday
items.title_zh: 農曆新年假期超市營業時間
items.desc: Major supermarkets including ParknShop, Wellcome, Mannings, Yata, and AEON have announced their operating hours during the Lunar New Year holiday period.
items.desc_zh: 百佳、惠康、萬寧、一田、AEON等主要超市已公布農曆新年假期期間的營業時間。

sections.title: 📈 港股關注 - 萬國數據 GDS

items.title: GDS Holdings Expects Higher 2026 Bookings Driven by Strong AI Demand in China
items.title_zh: 萬國數據預計2026年預訂增長 受中國AI需求推動
items.desc: GDS Holdings expects higher bookings in 2026 driven by strong AI demand in China. The company plans its first REIT asset injection in Q2 2026 involving assets valued at 4-6 billion RMB.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據預計2026年預訂量將增長，受中國強勁AI需求推動。公司計劃2026年第二季度進行首次REIT資產注入，涉及資產價值約40-60億元人民幣。

items.title: UBS Maintains GDS as Industry Top Pick, Bullish on New Orders and DayOne Valuation
items.title_zh: 瑞銀維持萬國數據為行業首選 看好新訂單及DayOne估值
items.desc: UBS continues to list GDS Holdings as its industry top pick, optimistic about potential new orders and DayOne's Series C funding valuation. The company's data center assets remain in high demand.
items.desc_zh: 瑞銀續列萬國數據為行業首選，看好潛在新訂單及DayOne C輪融資估值。公司數據中心資產需求保持強勁。

items.title: GDS REIT Listing Marks New Phase in Data Center Asset Securitization
items.title_zh: 萬國數據REIT上市標誌數據中心資產證券化新階段
items.desc: The Southern GDS Data Center Public REIT listed on Shanghai Stock Exchange in August 2025 as one of China's first data center REITs, marking a new phase in industry asset securitization.
items.desc_zh: 南方萬國數據中心公募REIT於2025年8月在上海證券交易所上市，作為中國首批數據中心REITs之一，標誌著行業資產證券化新階段。

items.title: Security Experts Warn About OpenClaw AI Agent Risks
items.title_zh: 安全專家警告OpenClaw AI代理風險
items.desc: Fortune reports that security experts are concerned about OpenClaw's risks. Permission misconfigurations could accidentally give OpenClaw more authority than users realize, allowing attackers to exploit the system.
items.desc_zh: 《財富》雜誌報導，安全專家對OpenClaw風險表示擔憂。權限配置錯誤可能意外給予OpenClaw過多權限，讓攻擊者有機可乘。

items.title: OpenClaw Scanner: New Open-Source Tool Detects Autonomous AI Agents
items.title_zh: OpenClaw Scanner：新開源工具檢測自主AI代理
items.desc: Astrix Security released an open-source scanner that can detect autonomous AI agents including OpenClaw instances. The company plans to expand capabilities based on demand.
items.desc_zh: Astrix Security發布開源掃描器，可檢測包括OpenClaw實例在內的自主AI代理。公司計劃根據需求擴展功能。

items.title: Infostealer Malware Targets OpenClaw AI Agent Configuration Files
items.title_zh: 信息竊取惡意軟件針對OpenClaw AI代理配置文件
items.desc: The Hacker News reports that infostealer malware is now stealing OpenClaw AI agent configuration files and gateway tokens. OpenClaw announced a partnership with VirusTotal to scan for malicious skills.
items.desc_zh: The Hacker News報導，信息竊取惡意軟件現正竊取OpenClaw AI代理配置文件和網關令牌。OpenClaw宣布與VirusTotal合作掃描惡意技能。

items.title: Cisco Finds Third-Party OpenClaw Skills Performing Data Exfiltration
items.title_zh: 思科發現第三方OpenClaw技能執行數據竊取
items.desc: Cisco's AI security research team tested a third-party OpenClaw skill and found it performed data exfiltration and prompt injection without user awareness. The skill repository lacked adequate vetting.
items.desc_zh: 思科AI安全研究團隊測試第三方OpenClaw技能，發現其在用戶不知情的情況下執行數據竊取和提示注入。技能庫缺乏充分審查。

items.title: Google Pixel 10a Officially Launched Today
items.title_zh: Google Pixel 10a 今日發布
items.desc: Google officially released the Pixel 10a smartphone on February 18. US carriers had already leaked full specifications. The device offers multiple colors with upgraded camera systems.
items.desc_zh: Google 於2月18日正式發布 Pixel 10a 智慧手機，美國電信商已提前洩露完整規格。新機將提供多種顏色選擇並搭載升級相機系統。

items.title: Global DRAM Memory Shortage: Tech Leaders Issue Warnings
items.title_zh: 全球DRAM記憶體短缺：科技領袖發出警告
items.desc: Musk (Tesla) and Cook (Apple) warn that AI boom causes severe DRAM shortage, potentially devastating corporate profits. Micron describes this bottleneck as 'unprecedented.' Apple reportedly accepted Kioxia's doubled memory prices.
items.desc_zh: 馬斯克和庫克警告，AI熱潮導致DRAM嚴重短缺，可能重創企業利潤。美光形容此瓶頸「前所未見」。蘋果據報已接受鎧俠翻倍記憶體價格。
